end.summary: Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying 3D shapes using features such as flat faces, round sides and pointed ends. They correctly described a cylinder and identified a rocket tip as a cone. They mixed up a shape’s name when it was turned and treated every box as a cube; neither mix-up was corrected later. At home, ask them to turn a cone or cylinder and explain why its shape name stays the same, then check whether a box has six equal square faces before calling it a cube.
